newsitem.title: UK: Britain jails American for filming young girls.
newsitem.headline: Britain jails American for filming young girls.

text.p: An American man who filmed girls as young as three or four years old as they played sometimes in the nude on Britain's holiday beaches was on Thursday jailed for four months and recommended for deportation.
Charles Morgan, 44, had admitted three charges of taking indecent photographs of children during August.
Magistrates at Bournemouth in southern England were told that Morgan, an unmarried postman from Seaside, California, had taken film of girls concentrating on their genital areas.
Magistrates said: "Our decision reflects our concern everyone should be able to enjoy themselves on the beaches or elsewhere without the fear of this sort of intrusion into their privacy."
Morgan was arrested when he was spotted with his video camera by a beach inspector at Bournemouth, who noticed he was playing particular attention to young girls.
Police found a tape in his pocket which had various shots of young girls on the beach. In his hotel room four more tapes were found with a diary which said: "Shot some nice scenes today".
Morgan admitted he had used the camcorder to film girls aged between four and 15, some partially clothed and some nude, and said he got sexual excitement from that type of film.
